source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 3 同主题完形(法式晚宴/印度香料/英式甜点/意大利咖啡习俗/中国饺子/移民与食物)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: My First French Dinner Party
passages.text: On my first weekend abroad, I went to a dinner party with my host family to (1)____ the New Year. I was confused until I learned about a special (4)____ called the kings' cake. A small toy was (5)____ inside it, and the children hid so they could not see who would get the lucky (6)____. From time to time during my stay, little differences like this took me by (7)____. I felt a kind of culture (8)____, the strange feeling you get in a new country. Luckily, I had learned useful (9)____ to help me deal with these ups and downs. Looking back, I am glad I kept an open (10)____ and tried to understand.

passages.title: The Taste of India
passages.text: Indian cooking is famous all over the world for its rich (1)____. Cooks there use lots of spices, (2)____ ginger, chilli pepper and black pepper, to give each dish a strong taste. Each region has its own (7)____ dishes, passed down through families for many years. Some visitors find Indian food a little (8)____ at first, but most soon learn to love it. If you ever travel there, keep an open mind and (9)____ as many new dishes as you can. You may (10)____ a whole new world of flavour.

passages.title: A Sweet British Habit

passages.title: Coffee, Italian Style
passages.text: When I studied in Italy, I quickly learned that coffee comes with its own (1)____. In the morning, Italians enjoy a milky cappuccino, but they almost never (2)____ one after lunch. To them, a milky coffee in the afternoon seems (3)____, like having breakfast at night. If you order a cappuccino after a big meal, the waiter may give you a (4)____ look. At first this small rule (5)____ me by surprise, and I felt a little embarrassed. But my Italian friends kindly (6)____ the custom to me. They told me that, after lunch, locals usually (7)____ a small, strong espresso instead. Once I understood the (8)____ behind the habit, it made perfect sense. Now, whenever I travel, I try to learn the local food (9)____ before I order. A few minutes of asking can save you from many funny (10)____.

passages.title: Making Dumplings Together
passages.text: One of my best memories of China is the night my host family taught me to make (1)____. Then we dropped them into a big pot of (5)____ water on the stove. While we waited, my host father (6)____ that in the north, dumplings are a favourite food for the New Year. He said their shape is (7)____ to stand for good luck and wealth. When the dumplings were finally (8)____, we ate them hot with a little vinegar. That simple meal was more (9)____ to me than any restaurant dinner. Making food together, I learned, is one of the best ways to (10)____ a new culture.

passages.title: Food That Travels with You
